title: Project Manager
jobDescription:
About Us We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission-critical applications. About the role The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within the Radar, EW & Communications department. Based in Hyderabad or Bangalore, this role will work closely with the VP – Technical Director to manage cross-functional teams comprising Product Leads, Developers, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). The Project Manager will ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with technical and business objectives. This role requires strong coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to lead teams of 4–12 members and drive successful project outcomes in a dynamic, technology-driven environment Responsibilities Accountability: Taking ownership of project outcomes, fostering transparency, and upholding integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Prioritizing timely delivery with a focus on ensuring customer satisfaction. Customer Relation Ship Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients through regular communication. Engage with the client weekly to establish effective communication channels. Team Leadership: Build and lead a strong, motivated, and goal-driven team, fostering a collaborative and productive environment. Project Planning:Create comprehensive project plans outlining tasks, timelines, resources, and milestones. Process Adherence: Ensuring adherence to project management methodologies, standards, and best practices throughout the project lifecycle to maintain consistency and quality in project execution. Implement and enforce best practices to optimize project efficiency and quality. Documentation Planning and Coordination: Develop a documentation plan outlining the types of documents required throughout the project lifecycle. Tracking and Monitoring: Implement systems and tools to track project progress, including task assignments, resource allocation, and budget utilization. Reporting and Analysis: Generate regular status reports summarizing project progress, accomplishments, and challenges. Delivery Planning & Execution towards closures: Collaborate with Delivery Team and coordinate Delivery activities, ensuring all tasks are completed on time and within Budget. Training/Mentoring: Providing guidance, training, and mentorship to team members to enhance their skills and capabilities, ultimately contributing to project success. Project Budget Tracking: Monitoring and managing the project budget, tracking expenses, and ensuring that the project remains within budget constraints while delivering the desired outcomes. Training/Mentoring: Providing guidance, training, and mentorship to team members to enhance their skills and capabilities, ultimately contributing to project success. Effective Work Allocation: Assigning tasks and responsibilities to team members based on their strengths, skills, and availability to optimize productivity and achieve project goals. Support in Recruitment: Participating in the recruitment process by defining job roles, interviewing candidates, and selecting suitable team members with the required skills and expertise. Project Budget Tracking: Monitoring and managing the project budget, tracking expenses, and ensuring that the project remains within budget constraints while delivering the desired outcomes. Required Qualifications Educational Background: Bachelor's OR master's degree in engineering, preferred in Electronics and Communications Engineering related field. Industry Experience: 3 to 4 years minimum of experience in Defence Segment. Technical Knowledge: Preferred understanding of radar or EW or Communications systems. Interpersonal Skills : Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to be extremely resourceful. Domain Expertise: Preferred understanding of radar or EW or Communications systems. Why join US? Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference. Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement. Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology. Experience: Apply Senior Software Engineer + About Us We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission-critical applications. About the Role We are building a high-performance, enterprise-grade application designed to process and analyze large-scale data in real time, enabling advanced visualization and decision-making. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on contributor across backend and frontend systems, owning the design and implementation of major components in our data-intensive workflows. This role is for an experienced individual contributor who enjoys deep technical work on real-time data systems, signal processing workflows, and interactive visualization platforms, and who takes pride in raising the engineering bar around them. Key Responsibilities Design and build backend and frontend systems for high-throughput, real-time data applications, owning the implementation of major components end to end. Develop backend services, APIs, and data processing logic that ingest and analyze large volumes of sensor and signal data with low latency. Build event-driven services using Kafka for streaming and Redis for caching and shared state. Build performant, data-heavy frontend applications — dashboards, charts, and real-time visualizations capable of handling large datasets across devices. Write tested, reviewed, well-documented code and champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews and technical discussions. Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team. Collaborate with data scientists, electronics engineers, and UI/UX designers to translate requirements into working systems. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong exposure to data-driven and real-time applications. Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e.g., C++, C# or Python), with hands-on experience building scalable, distributed systems. Strong experience building data-intensive frontend applications using React (or a comparable modern framework) with Type Script, including performance optimization, state management, and visualization libraries such as D3.js, ECharts, Plotly, or Highcharts. Hands-on experience with Kafka (or comparable event streaming platforms) and Redis for caching and shared state. Strong fundamentals in relational databases (Postgre SQL or equivalent), including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. Comfortable on Linux, with Git-based workflows, containerized deployment (Docker), and CI pipelines. Demonstrated practice with unit and integration testing (pytest, JUnit, Jest, or equivalent). Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with time-series databases (Timescale DB, Influx DB, or similar) for sensor and telemetry workloads. Experience with on-premises or LAN-based deployment of real-time systems. Familiarity with Web Sockets, Server-Sent Events, or g RPC for streaming data to clients. Experience with observability stacks (structured logging, Prometheus/Grafana, or comparable). Exposure to signal processing, DSP, or sensor telemetry domains. Why Join Us? Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference. Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement. Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology. Experience: Apply Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer + About Us We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. Employee status and commitments Permanent full-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit. Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time. Weekend work is rare but can occasionally be necessary. Why join US? Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference. Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement. Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology. Experience: Apply Sr. DSP Algorithm Engineer + About Us We are a dynamic team of engineers, researchers, and domain experts who build advanced signal processing solutions for Defence, Aerospace, and Research applications . Our work spans high-performance communication systems, Telemetry Receivers, Radar Processing, and mission-critical signal processing platforms. We focus on solving complex real-world problems by developing state-of-the-art DSP algorithms and high-performance implementations for RF, FPGA, Embedded Processors, and high-speed computing platforms. About the role We are looking for a Sr. Algorithm Developer – DSP who can design, analyze, and implement advanced signal processing algorithms from first principles. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real-world deployment. The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization. Key Responsibilities Study and derive algorithms from IEEE papers, research publications, standards, and technical documentation . Develop DSP algorithms for Digital Communication systems and Radar Signal Processing . Design algorithms for: Modulation & demodulation (PCM/FM, SOQPSK, CPM, QPSK, QAM etc.) Synchronization (carrier, symbol, timing recovery) Channel coding & decoding (LDPC, Turbo, Reed-Solomon, etc.) Filtering, estimation, and detection algorithms Radar signal processing techniques Implement algorithms using MATLAB / Python for modelling and simulation. Convert algorithms into high-performance implementations in C/C++ or FPGA-friendly architectures using RTL. Validate algorithms through simulation, mathematical analysis, and test data. Analyze existing algorithm implementations and improve: Accuracy Computational efficiency Latency Robustness in real-world conditions Optimize algorithms for hardware acceleration platforms (FPGA/GPU/embedded processors). Work closely with FPGA, embedded software, and RF teams to integrate algorithms into system-level designs. Support testing, debugging, and performance evaluation of deployed systems. Participate in technical problem solving and architectural discussions. Document algorithms, simulation results, and performance evaluations. Stay updated with latest developments in signal processing and communication theory. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering from a reputed institution. 4–8 years of experience in system development involving both software and hardware components. Strong understanding of DSP, RF systems, and communications/radar technologies. Proficiency in one or more tools/languages: Lab VIEW, C/C++, MATLAB, Verilog/VHDL. Experience managing small technical teams and working in cross-functional setups. Familiarity with projects involving government agencies or DRDO is a plus. Excellent communication and documentation skills for client and internal reporting. Strong fundamentals in: Digital Signal Processing Digital Communications Probability & Random Processes Estimation Theory Employee status and commitments Permanent full-time position, located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on-site visits to clients and vendor locations. Why join US? Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference. Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement. Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented V&V (Verification & Validation) Engineer – Senior to join our engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional development teams throughout the product lifecycle, contributing to test planning, validation strategies, troubleshooting support, and system-level verification activities. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in test methodologies, automation frameworks, RF and digital test environments, and requirements-based testing. The role also involves field testing, documentation, and supporting continuous integration workflows to ensure reliable and high-quality product releases. Key Responsibilities Develop comprehensive verification and validation plans for embedded, RF, and signal processing systems. Define acceptance criteria, test strategies, and requirements-based validation methodologies. Collaborate closely with FPGA, software, hardware, and system engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle. Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Python and related tools. Perform RF and digital hardware testing using lab equipment and automated test setups. Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing environments. Plan and execute field testing activities for SIGINT and related systems. Analyze system failures, assist in troubleshooting, and provide validation insights to development teams. Maintain regression testing workflows for software and FPGA releases where applicable. Generate and maintain technical documentation, test reports, validation records, and compliance documentation. Support CI/CD and automated test execution using Jenkins, Git Lab CI, or similar tools. Ensure adherence to applicable testing standards and internal quality processes. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Embedded Systems, Instrumentation, Computer Engineering, or related field. 4+ years of experience in Verification & Validation, System Testing, or Integration Testing. Strong programming skills in Python with experience in automation frameworks such as Py VISA and pytest. Experience working with RF and digital test equipment and automated measurement setups. Good understanding of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) frameworks. Experience in test planning, test case development, and requirements-based testing. Familiarity with Jenkins, Git Lab CI, or similar CI/CD tools. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience in technical documentation and reporting using La Te X, Confluence, or similar tools. Knowledge of FPGA validation and automated regression testing is an added advantage. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in cross-functional teams. Willingness to travel for field trials and on-site testing activities when required. EMPLOYEE STATUS AND COMMITMENTS Permanent full-time position based at our Hyderabad office. Involvement in on-site integration, customer demonstrations, and field trials as required. Experience: Apply IT& Networking Manager + About Us We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. We are looking for The IT and Security Manager must have at least 6+ Years of experience, having played a key role in the installation, configuration, and day-to-day maintenance of IT support, security and management systems. This role ensures business continuity through hands-on troubleshooting, user support , and system upkeep. The position suits candidates who demonstrate basic independence in executing all essential IT and support tasks and who are eager to grow into more advanced responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Managing the following: Server ( IP addressing , DNS and DHCP , Switch and Router configuration, Network topology and traffic analysis, Monitoring tools like PRTG, Solar Winds) Network (Windows and Linux servers, setting up Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Backup and Restore products, Virtualization using VMware or Hyper-V) Antivirus (Centralized antivirus console such as Symantec, Mc Afee, Virus signature update, Policy enforcement) Managing Security across: Email (Gateways, encryption, DLP policies) Firewall (Configuration using Sophos, IDS and IPS, VPN setup and secure access, Log monitoring) Network (Segmentation and VLANs based on guidance, SIEM tools, Regular vulnerability scans, Threat analysis and incident response) Owning, implementing, monitoring, resolving and managing the following: Endpoint Management (EDR tools, MDM, USB control , Device encryption and hardening) Backup and Disaster Recovery (RTO and RPO, DR planning, Backup and Restoration strategies, tools like Veeam, Acronis or native solutions) Cloud Security (GCP basics, AWS, Azure, IAM roles and policies, Data encryption in transit and rest, Cloud monitoring and billing alerts) Asset and Inventory ( CMDB or IT asset tools, Software licensing compliance, Tagging and Documentation) Access and Identity (RBAC, MFA , SSO) Change and Patch management (Change request process, test patching in staging environments, Document changes) Compliance and Audit (Understanding of standards { ISO 27001 , GDPR, etc}) Incident Response and Reporting (Basic Forensic steps, Logging and Escalation protocols, working with Info Sec or external consultants) IT Documentation (Network diagrams, System configuration logs, Access control lists, SOPs) User Awareness and Support (Communicating IT policies, Basic Security Awareness training, Timely user support and resolution of tickets ) Install, configure, Troubleshoot, desktops/laptops across Windows, Linux, and mac OS systems. Support user account management and authentication services via Active Directory. Configure basic email filtering rules to block spam or phishing attempts. Manage roles, access controls billing alerts on platforms like Microsoft365 Track and update assets using basic CMDB or inventory tools . Assist with preparing audit reports by gathering required data and logs. Escalate incidents to support teams with relevant documentation. Maintain accurate SOPs, system access logs , and user guides. Maintain up to date IT infrastructure records across the organization. Required Qualifications A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is typically preferred. A master's degree can be an advantage. Minimum 6+ years of hands-on experience in IT support, system administration, and information security roles. Proven track record of managing and troubleshooting complex IT and security systems. Experience in a role that requires basic independence in executing all essential IT and support tasks. Demonstrated eagerness and ability to grow into more advanced responsibilities. SOFT SKILLS Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills Strong communication skills (written and verbal) for technical and non-technical audiences Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Proactive and able to take initiative. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively. Customer-service oriented approach to user support. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Kernel & Driver Development: Design and optimize Linux kernel modules and user-space I/O (UIO/VFIO) drivers to interface with PL peripherals, managing DMA transactions and interrupt handling with microsecond-level precision. Asymmetric Multi-Processing (AMP): Implement complex AMP architectures using Open AMP and Libmetal to orchestrate communication and resource sharing between the Application Processing Unit (Linux on A53/A72) and Real-Time Processing Unit (Free RTOS/Bare-metal on R5). RFDC & Versal AI Software Integration: Develop software applications and API wrappers to configure and control RF Data Converter (RFDC) blocks or Versal AI Engines, ensuring correct initialization, calibration, and data streaming initiation from the PS side. System Performance: Analyse and optimize Linux system performance, including CPU scheduling, memory management, and network stack tuning to handle high-throughput data streams typical in defence DSP applications. Required Qualifications Core Experience: Bachelor’s or Masters in VLSI or Embedded Engineering or Computer Science engineering with 5+ years of dedicated experience in Embedded Linux development on ARMv8 architectures (Zynq MPSo C/RFSo C or Versal ACAP). Embedded Linux Mastery: Deep understanding of the Linux kernel internals, device tree customization (.dtsi), U-Boot, and the Yocto build system hierarchy (bitbake, recipes, layers). Experience: Apply Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer + About Us We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. Employee status and commitments Permanent full-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit. Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time. Experience: Apply Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer + About Us We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. Employee status and commitments Permanent full-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit. Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time. Weekend work is rare but can occasionally be necessary. Why join US? Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference. Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement. Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized. Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real-world deployment. The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization. Key Responsibilities Study and derive algorithms from IEEE papers, research publications, standards, and technical documentation . Develop DSP algorithms for Digital Communication systems and Radar Signal Processing . Design algorithms for: Modulation & demodulation (PCM/FM, SOQPSK, CPM, QPSK, QAM etc.) Synchronization (carrier, symbol, timing recovery) Channel coding & decoding (LDPC, Turbo, Reed-Solomon, etc.) Filtering, estimation, and detection algorithms Radar signal processing techniques Implement algorithms using MATLAB / Python for modelling and simulation. Convert algorithms into high-performance implementations in C/C++ or FPGA-friendly architectures using RTL. Validate algorithms through simulation, mathematical analysis, and test data. Work closely with FPGA, embedded software, and RF teams to integrate algorithms into system-level designs. Support testing, debugging, and performance evaluation of deployed systems. Participate in technical problem solving and architectural discussions. Document algorithms, simulation results, and performance evaluations. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. Employee status and commitments Permanent full-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit. Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time. Experience: Apply Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer + About Us We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications. About the role As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications. The role includes RF signal-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system-level requirements into circuit-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Analysis Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front-end modules up to 40 GHz. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Required Qualifications Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field. 8+ years of hands-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent. Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters. Experience designing with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Familiarity with MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, and MIL-HDBK-217 requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment Preferred S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with Ga N/Ga As/Si Ge/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices. Define component derating, worst-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high-reliability aerospace and defence hardware. Translate system-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers. Perform RF system and circuit-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1d B, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance. Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system-level co-simulation. Systems Architecture & Integration Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module-level implementation planning. Lead antenna-to-baseband RF signal-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down-converter applications. Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface. Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements. Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed-signal partitioning. Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high-power PA thermal design. Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces. Product Development & Qualification Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1d B, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. Perform prototype bring-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL-STD-461 EMC and MIL-STD-810 environmental requirements. Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support. Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence. Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers.
